description: This file provides the structure and styling for a Database Viewer web application, allowing users to browse tables and data from connected databases.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders an HTML table based on the provided data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a table cell based on its value.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a cell to show full content when clicked.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in the specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in the specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays an empty state message in the specified element.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the active state for a specified element.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches data from the specified URL.
